chunks: The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: Drink water of the sky (rain), for it purifies the body and repels diseases.

God, Mighty and Majestic, said: 'And He sends down upon you water from the sky to purify you thereby, and remove from you the uncleanness of Satan, and to fortify your hearts and steady (your) footsteps thereby.' [8:11]

key_terms.الْأَقْدَامَ: The footsteps/feet — steadfastness and firmness in action and faith
key_terms.رِجْزَ الشَّيْطَانِ: Uncleanness/filth of Satan — spiritual impurity introduced by the devil
key_terms.مَاءَ السَّمَاءِ: Water of the sky/rain — considered the purest form of water in classical Islamic medicine
key_terms.يُطَهِّرُ الْبَدَنَ: Purifies the body — both physical cleanliness and ritual purity

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about drinking rainwater and its benefits?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him), as narrated by Imam al-Sadiq (AS), commands drinking rainwater, citing both its physical and spiritual benefits. He substantiates this recommendation by quoting Quran 8:11, which speaks of rain sent during the Battle of Badr to purify the believers, remove Satanic impurity, and strengthen their resolve. In Islamic medicine and tradition, rainwater was considered the purest natural water with both physical and spiritual purifying properties.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Abu Baseer, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Drink water of the sky (rain) for it purifies the body and dispels the diseases.

Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Said [8:11] and Sent down upon you water from the sky that He might thereby Purify you, and Take away from you the uncleanness of the Satan, and that He might Fortify your hearts and Steady (your) footsteps thereby’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hassan ibn Rashid from abu Basir who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has stated this Hadith. ‘’Amir al-Mu’minin has said, ‘You should drink of the water of the sky, it cleanses the body and removes illnesses

as Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, has said, “He sends water from the sky to cleanse you with it and remove the filth of Satan from you and to make your hearts firmly related and to make you steadfast.” [8:11]’”
